name: Strength
description: Master strength: scales the episode intensity E and the rest amounts; 0 turns the pass off.

name: Episode period
description: An ambient episode every this many seconds, at the end of each period; 0 leaves episodes to events only.

name: Episode duty
description: Share of each period an ambient episode lasts (a smooth bell).

name: Wobble at rest
description: Largest sideways push of the signal bands outside episodes.

name: Wobble in episode
description: Largest sideways push of the signal bands at the peak of an episode.

name: Wobble band height
description: Height of the tall wobble bands; a second layer of bands is about 0.3 of this.

name: Wobble speed
description: How often the wobble bands are re-rolled.

name: Tracking kick
description: Sideways kick of the two tracking lines (one left, one right).

name: Tracking line height
description: Half height of each tracking kink.

name: Tracking sweep A
description: Sweeps per second of the line that kicks left.

name: Tracking sweep B
description: Sweeps per second of the line that kicks right.

name: Colour fringe
description: Constant offset of red and blue from green, in opposite directions.

name: Fringe growth
description: Extra fringe per pixel of local wobble, so torn bands show red and blue edges.

name: Slice tears at rest
description: Share of slices torn sideways outside episodes.

name: Slice tears in episode
description: Share of slices torn sideways at the peak of an episode.

name: Slice height
description: Height of the horizontal slices (shared by slice tears and slice flashes).

name: Slice displacement
description: Largest sideways shift of a torn slice; groups share a smaller common offset.

name: Slice group
description: Neighbouring slices per coarse chunk that shares a common offset.

name: Slice tear rate
description: How often the set of torn slices is re-picked.

name: Blocks at rest
description: Amount of block corruption outside episodes.

name: Blocks in episode
description: Amount of block corruption at the peak of an episode.

name: Block size
description: Scale of the block stripes (1: row stripes about 11 px, column stripes about 56 px).

name: Block displacement
description: Largest sideways shift of the copy shown inside a block.

name: Block colour split
description: Red and blue offset inside a block.

name: Block brightness
description: How much brighter a block is than the picture.

name: Block rate
description: How often the blocks are re-rolled (they blink).

name: Slice flashes at rest
description: Share of slices flashing outside episodes.

name: Slice flashes in episode
description: Share of slices flashing at the peak of an episode.

name: Flash strength
description: Extra light in a flashing slice (0.33: a third more).

name: Flash rate
description: How often the flashing slices are re-picked.

name: Noise band at rest
description: Strength of the noise band outside episodes.

name: Noise band in episode
description: Strength of the noise band at the peak of an episode.

name: Noise band cell
description: Size of the noise band's blocky cells.

name: Noise band smallest
description: Smallest band height, as a share of the glass height.

name: Noise band largest
description: Largest band height, as a share of the glass height.

name: Noise band rate
description: How often the band jumps to a new place and size.

name: Static at rest
description: Per-pixel white noise outside episodes.

name: Static in episode
description: Per-pixel white noise at the peak of an episode.

name: Static rate
description: How often the static is re-rolled.

name: Line pulse at rest
description: Depth of the dense brightness ripple outside episodes.

name: Line pulse in episode
description: Depth of the dense brightness ripple at the peak of an episode.

name: Line pulse pitch
description: Distance between ripple crests.

name: Line pulse drift
description: Drift of the ripple; positive moves it up, negative down.
